name: Barbell Clean and Jerk
steps: Stand with a barbell over your midfoot, hinge and bend your knees to grip it just outside your shins, and brace your back flat.
Drive through your feet to lift the bar closely, extend explosively at your thighs, and catch it on your shoulders.
Stand tall with the bar racked, dip straight down slightly at the knees, and drive explosively upward.
Split or drop beneath the rising bar to catch it locked straight overhead, then bring your feet back under your hips.
Lower the bar smoothly back to your shoulders and down to the floor under control.
tips: Finish the leg drive before dropping under the rising bar, then receive it with your elbows straight.
Stabilize the bar overhead with feet aligned under your hips before lowering it.
